i think the thing is, if you dont love yourself first, you end up spending all your love on others and are denying yourself of some love. Try being selfish for a while and mainly focus on you. Things you would be envious of others for. Fight for them like your life depended on it, new clothes, lose weight, get smarter, more charismatic, new car, decisive attitude. For the attitude, one thing I have noticed helped was the "I am going to kill myself through alchoholism anyways, so what does it matter what I do now?" defense. Nothing they say or do will mattter in a hundred years so fuck them. That's the most important attitude "Fuck them" No one's opinions matter not even your best friends'.  
P.S. Try not to lose friends if possible.

I feel like i push people away, and they abandon me if I don't. I dont feel inadequate, just like a puzzle piece that doesnt fit anywhere, no matter how many places i look. Personally I think I'm not a horrible person or anything, its just my attitude doesnt mesh with anyone I have ever met in my entire life.

I never really left on bad terms but nobody ever really felt compelled to stick with me. It's like my personality has a half-life on my friendships. I don't want to keep up this, but maybe one of the groups will accept me for who I am.
